$comment: Lock-In copy pools. The app picks a random line from a pool, avoiding the last one shown. Placeholders: {team}, {pub}, {round}, {n}, {seconds}. A venue theme can override or extend any pool.
taglines: The quiz that stays open late.
Answers locked. Next round's on you.
Phones out. For once, that's allowed.
Where good guesses go to die.
Your table versus the world. Well, the pub.

lobby: Grab a drink. Pick a silly name.
Warming up the questions. Warm up your brain.
Name your team. Choose wisely, it goes on the telly.
team_joined: {team} is here. The others look nervous.
round_start: Round {round}. Someone go to the bar first.
locked: Your answer is in the vault.
all_locked: Full house. Let's see the damage.
reveal: Let's see who was paying attention.
Answers coming up. Avert your eyes.
lead_change: All change at the top. Hello, {team}.
{team} has entered the chat. And first place.
close_race: Tighter than the parking out back.
halftime: Halfway. Plenty of time to panic.
tiebreak: Level on points. One question settles it.
last_place: {team}, you were here, and that counts.
Wooden spoon to {team}. Wear it proudly.
goodbye: That's a wrap. Same time next week?
Thanks for playing at {pub}. Get home safe.
Last orders. For real this time.
